# Lineup Confirmed

> Starting goalies, probable pitchers and game-day lineups, each marked expected or confirmed with its source.

Lineup Confirmed tracks who is starting today across sports: NHL starting goalies, MLB probable pitchers and closers, NBA injury status, Premier League lineups and NFL starting quarterbacks. Every starter is labeled expected or confirmed and linked to its source.

Search and AI crawlers may read this site. Published articles list public sources. Cite the article URL and those sources when you rely on a story.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lineupconfirmed.com/): Latest stories

- [NHL Starting Goalies](https://lineupconfirmed.com/nhl/starting-goalies/): Tonight's NHL starters, game by game, marked expected or confirmed with the team or reporter source.

- [NBA Injury Status](https://lineupconfirmed.com/nba/injury-status/): Who is in, out or questionable tonight, from official team and league reports.

- [Premier League Lineups](https://lineupconfirmed.com/soccer/premier-league-lineups/): Confirmed Premier League starting elevens, published when clubs release them.

- [NFL Starting QBs](https://lineupconfirmed.com/nfl/starting-qbs/): Quarterback starts, benchings and injuries. News only, no fantasy advice.

- [MLB Probable Pitchers](https://lineupconfirmed.com/mlb/probable-pitchers/): Probable starting pitchers for every game, from club announcements.

- [MLB Closers](https://lineupconfirmed.com/mlb/closers/): Closer and bullpen role changes, sourced to managers and team reporters.

- [Archive](https://lineupconfirmed.com/archive/): Every published story
- [About](https://lineupconfirmed.com/about/): Desk, sourcing rules, and corrections
- [Sources & Ethics](https://lineupconfirmed.com/sources-ethics/): Editorial standards
- [Corrections](https://lineupconfirmed.com/corrections/): How a factual error is corrected
- [Contact Us](https://lineupconfirmed.com/contact/): Message the desk. The thank-you page is not indexed.

## Published articles



- [Connor Hellebuyck Says He Is Ready for His Devils Debut; Tuesday Starter at Dallas Not Named](https://lineupconfirmed.com/articles/devils-connor-hellebuyck-ready-debut-stars-avalanche-oct-27-2026/): Connor Hellebuyck practiced with New Jersey for the first time Monday and said he could play today. Coach Sheldon Keefe wants him involved on the three-game trip but is taking it day by day.

- [Flames' Devin Cooley Has Started Three Straight Wins Before Maple Leafs Visit](https://lineupconfirmed.com/articles/flames-devin-cooley-three-straight-wins-maple-leafs-oct-26-2026/): Devin Cooley has started each of Calgary's three straight wins ahead of Monday's game with Toronto. Here is where both creases stand before any starter is announced.

- [NHL Starting Goalies Tuesday, Oct. 27, 2026: Early Look at the 11-Game Slate](https://lineupconfirmed.com/articles/nhl-starting-goalies-tuesday-oct-27-2026/): Tuesday has 11 NHL games and no announced starters yet. Here is who started each team’s last game, from official box scores, plus the Kings back-to-back.

- [NHL Starting Goalies Wednesday, Oct. 28: Logan Thompson Back at Practice; Devils on a Back-to-Back](https://lineupconfirmed.com/articles/nhl-starting-goalies-wednesday-oct-28-2026/): Wednesday has four NHL games and no announced starters yet. Capitals goalie Logan Thompson returned to practice Monday, and New Jersey plays the second half of a back-to-back at Colorado.

- [Oilers Goalies Without Devon Levi: Tristan Jarry and Matt Tomkins Before Red Wings Game](https://lineupconfirmed.com/articles/oilers-goalies-without-devon-levi-vs-red-wings-oct-26-2026/): With Devon Levi on injured reserve, Edmonton has Tristan Jarry and recalled Matt Tomkins for Monday's game against Detroit. Neither team has named a starter yet.

- [Rangers Add James Reimer as Dylan Garand's Workload Grows Before Kings Game](https://lineupconfirmed.com/articles/rangers-james-reimer-signs-garand-workload-kings-oct-26-2026/): The Rangers signed 38-year-old James Reimer on Sunday, a day before hosting the Kings. Here is what is known about Monday's crease and what has not been announced.

- [Red Wings Turn to Michal Postava for His First NHL Start at Edmonton; Jarry in Goal for Oilers](https://lineupconfirmed.com/articles/red-wings-michal-postava-first-nhl-start-oilers-oct-26-2026/): Detroit coach Todd McLellan named 24-year-old Michal Postava as Monday's starter at Edmonton, his first NHL start. The Oilers announced Tristan Jarry for the home side.

- [Canucks Project Leevi Merilainen vs. Wild as Quinn Hughes Returns, Oct. 25, 2026](https://lineupconfirmed.com/articles/canucks-leevi-merilainen-projected-vs-wild-oct-25-2026/): Leevi Merilainen is projected to start for Vancouver against Minnesota on Sunday after Kevin Lankinen played Thursday. Calvin Pickard is confirmed for the Wild.

- [Islanders Expect Ilya Sorokin vs. Jake Oettinger in Dallas, Oct. 25, 2026](https://lineupconfirmed.com/articles/islanders-ilya-sorokin-expected-at-stars-oct-25-2026/): The Islanders' own game preview says Ilya Sorokin is expected to start at Dallas on Sunday, against an expected Jake Oettinger. Neither start had been officially confirmed when we published.

- [Jets Goalie for Heritage Classic: Skinner or Stevenson After Hellebuyck Trade; Canadiens Starter Not Announced](https://lineupconfirmed.com/articles/jets-goalie-heritage-classic-after-hellebuyck-trade-oct-25-2026/): Winnipeg plays its first game since trading Connor Hellebuyck to New Jersey with Stuart Skinner and Clay Stevenson as its two NHL goalies. Neither the Jets nor the Canadiens had confirmed a Heritage Classic starter in the sources we checked.

- [NHL Starting Goalies Monday, Oct. 26, 2026: Kings-Rangers, Leafs-Flames, Red Wings-Oilers](https://lineupconfirmed.com/articles/nhl-starting-goalies-monday-oct-26-2026/): Monday evening update: James Reimer, Sergei Bobrovsky, Devin Cooley, Michal Postava and Tristan Jarry are confirmed, and Darcy Kuemper is expected for the Kings.

- [NHL Starting Goalies Tonight (Sunday, Oct. 25, 2026): Schmid, Knight and Pickard Confirmed; Sorokin, Oettinger, Fowler, Skinner Expected](https://lineupconfirmed.com/articles/nhl-starting-goalies-tonight-oct-25-2026/): Five NHL games Sunday. Akira Schmid and Spencer Knight started in Chicago, and Calvin Pickard is confirmed for Minnesota. Sorokin, Oettinger, Fowler, Skinner, Wedgewood, Annunen and Merilainen are expected.

- [Panthers Confirm Akira Schmid in Goal at Blackhawks Tonight; Blackhawks Expected to Turn to Soderblom](https://lineupconfirmed.com/articles/panthers-akira-schmid-starts-at-blackhawks-oct-25-2026/): Florida confirms Akira Schmid starts Sunday at Chicago with Jacob Markstrom injured. NHL.com projects Arvid Soderblom for Chicago after Spencer Knight's five straight starts.

- [Predators Close Back-to-Back vs. Avalanche After Saros' 34-Save Night in Pittsburgh](https://lineupconfirmed.com/articles/predators-back-to-back-goalie-avalanche-oct-25-2026/): Nashville hosts Colorado on the second night of a back-to-back after Juuse Saros played Saturday in Pittsburgh, and the team is skipping its morning skate. Neither club has confirmed a starter.

- [Wild Confirm Calvin Pickard Starts at Canucks Tonight on Back-to-Back](https://lineupconfirmed.com/articles/wild-calvin-pickard-starts-at-canucks-oct-25-2026/): Minnesota coach John Hynes split the weekend back-to-back: Jesper Wallstedt started Saturday at Seattle and Calvin Pickard starts Sunday in Vancouver. The Canucks have not confirmed their goalie.
